seo__browser_title: Our story | Oakdene House Foundation, Fairfield
seo__search_description: Watch how Oakdene House supports people affected by addiction and gambling harm in Fairfield, Western Sydney, with free counselling, group programs and community services.
header__intro: Oakdene House offers free counselling and practical support to people affected by addiction and gambling harm in Fairfield. In this short film, people in recovery, our counsellors and our founding chairman talk about what that support means.
video__label: Play video: Oakdene House Foundation, our story
video__text: "It's like the chains have been cut and they get to be the best version of themselves again."
